caption:
the ring died at 3am. the morning still made sense

#wellness #fitnessapp #soma

slides.text:
No score this morning

Just a blank where
the night used to be

The watch still counted steps

The phone still knew I walked

One source went dark

The picture didn't

Charge the ring

Just don't build your mornings
on one battery

slides.heading: Built on all of them
slides.body: SOMA reads Oura, Whoop, Apple Health and more — when one device sleeps, the picture stays whole
